_readme: The whole menu, transcribed from the diner's printed menu (summer 2026). Items take an optional "desc" (one short line), "tag" (a small badge), and either "price" (just the number, like "6.75") or "prices" (a list of {"label", "price"} for things like cup and bowl). A section can carry its own "price" (when everything in it costs the same), "notes" (lines under the heading) and "extras" (add-ons shown under the list).

favorites.name: Biscuits & Gravy
favorites.text: Best in town, says the menu. Half or full order, or make it a plate with eggs, meat and potatoes.

favorites.name: Fried Mush
favorites.text: Five slices of golden fried mush. Add bacon, sausage or ham. Hard to find anywhere else.

favorites.name: Jill's Big Breakfast
favorites.text: Country fried steak or grilled tenderloin, three eggs, hash rounds or home fries, and a pancake or biscuits and gravy.

favorites.name: Pork Tenderloin
favorites.text: Grilled or hand breaded, served deluxe on a toasted bun. The Hoosier classic.

favorites.name: Big J Burger
favorites.text: A half pound of ground beef with cheese, served with chips. Make it a basket for fries and slaw.

favorites.name: Floats
favorites.text: Red cream, vanilla cream, Dreamsicle or root beer. Worth saving room for.
